mode.description: direct = inspection only today; gateway/rest-adapter = governed data-path seams

route_ref.description: Logical route identifier realized per environment (K8s HTTPRoute name, Apigee proxy, AWS API GW route, Azure APIM op)

policy_profile_ref.description: Reference to a policy profile carrying exposure_rules (E3)

backends.description: Backend identities the route may target (private FQDNs or LB-fronted ids — never raw IPs)

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 (today) / detached JWS (seam) over the canonical exposure block

approvals.description: Four-eyes publication — two distinct approvers required for mode: gateway (seam)

backend_identity.description: Pinned backend identity — connection fails closed on mismatch (seam)
